subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw add a plugin-facing current-session reset capability specifically to after_compaction hooks?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin API, and the repository history includes a broader reset API proposal that closed unmerged, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve narrow compaction API
options.body: Keep resetSession limited to after_compaction contexts and require lifecycle-owned deferred flushing, focused contract tests, and positive live proof.

options.title: Reject the core API
options.body: Keep session resets behind existing gateway or owner-controlled flows and move plugin-specific behavior outside this hook contract.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow compaction API
recommendation.body: Keep resetSession limited to after_compaction contexts and require lifecycle-owned deferred flushing, focused contract tests, and positive live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session-reset service and lifecycle-cleanup history make this the best available owner for the permanent reset contract.
